mapper.sql: select d.order_id, d.order_no, d.dept_id, d.user_id, d.user_name, d.status, d.total_count, d.order_remark, d.accept_by, d.accept_user_id, d.accept_time, d.finish_by, d.finish_time, d.cancel_time, d.assign_mode, d.assign_user_id, d.assign_user_name, d.deadline_time, d.close_reason, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.remark from meal_order d
mapper.select: select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.dept_id = #{deptId} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and r.role_key = 'meal_chef' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0'

select distinct u.user_id as userId, case when u.nick_name is null or u.nick_name = '' then u.user_name else u.nick_name end as nickName from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.dept_id = #{deptId} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and r.role_key = 'meal_chef' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' order by nickName asc

select u.user_id as userId, case when u.nick_name is null or u.nick_name = '' then u.user_name else u.nick_name end as nickName from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.dept_id = #{deptId} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and r.role_key = 'meal_chef' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' limit 1

select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.dept_id = #{deptId} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and r.role_key = 'meal_manager' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0'
select item_id, order_id, dish_id, dish_name, dish_cover, count, remark from meal_order_item where order_id = #{orderId} order by item_id asc
mapper.insert:
insert into meal_order_item (order_id, dish_id, dish_name, dish_cover, count, remark) values
(#{item.orderId}, #{item.dishId}, #{item.dishName}, #{item.dishCover}, #{item.count}, #{item.remark})
mapper.update:
update meal_order
status = #{status}, accept_by = #{acceptBy}, accept_time = sysdate(), accept_user_id = #{acceptUserId}, finish_by = #{finishBy}, finish_time = sysdate(), cancel_time = sysdate(), close_reason = #{closeReason}, assign_mode = #{assignMode}, deadline_time = #{deadlineTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()
where order_id = #{orderId} and del_flag = '0'
and status = #{expectedStatus}
and deadline_time is not null and deadline_time <= sysdate()
mapper.select: select max(order_no) from meal_order where order_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
where d.order_id = #{orderId} and d.del_flag = '0' for update
select d.order_id from meal_order d where d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0' and d.deadline_time is not null and d.deadline_time <= sysdate() order by d.deadline_time asc limit #{limit}

select d.order_id from meal_order d where d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from meal_order_candidate c where c.order_id = d.order_id and c.status in ('0', '4') ) order by d.create_time asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update meal_order set assign_mode = '2', deadline_time = #{deadlineTime}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = '0' and assign_mode = '1' and del_flag = '0'
